item.tib: spyi 'dul yang gsang rta dbu'i bsnyen sgrub phyag tu bzhes thabs dgos 'byung dbyig gi sgrom bu
item.coloph: de ltar yang gsang rta dbu'i bsnyen sgrub kyis/ lag len bsam dgu 'byung ba'i nor bu 'di/ lung dang slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal ngag las/ thos bzhin rang 'dra'i rmongs dbul bsal phyir du/ gshen po bstan 'dzin ming gis lam rtsam (tsam) bkod/ de yi dge bas ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ rgyal 'dus zhi khro'i go 'phangs ('phang)cher thob shog/
